steps.name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/docker@sha256:fbc05705e6f24467e40ae8a4097ab9b8fae1116551f838fa2c55f4367427fc36
args:
import os,stat,json,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/opt/ocean/beta-host-config.json')
m=json.loads(Path('/opt/ocean/serving-manifest.json').read_text())
a=json.loads(Path('/opt/ocean/source-manifest.json').read_text())
assert os.getuid()==10001 and os.getgid()==10001
assert os.environ['OCEAN_V1_HOST_CONFIG']==str(p)
assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and p.stat().st_uid==0 and stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==0o444
assert m['version']=='ocean-v1-beta-serving-api-context-v1' and m['revision']=='dcde1ef2c5332e9543c826b6185c5e746fbde410'
assert a['revision']==m['base_api_revision']=='7924a28e919b1fb751890c694f7b1f9b26b104ff'
assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==m['api_host_config_sha256']
assert not any(os.environ.get(k) for k in ['DATABASE_URL','OCEAN_V1_DATABASE_URL','V1_AUTH_SECRET','V1_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET'])
import beta_entry
beta_entry.validate_serving_source(os.environ)
assert 'api.main' not in sys.modules
print(json.dumps({'state':'configured_image_file_verified','revision':m['revision'],'base_api_revision':a['revision'],'uid':os.getuid(),'gid':os.getgid(),'config_root_owned':True,'config_regular_not_symlink':True,'config_mode':'0444','config_sha256':m['api_host_config_sha256'],'unchanged_entry_source_validation':True,'credentials_or_database_connection':False,'network':'none'}))
